title: Benson Boone Is a ‘Wanted Man’ In Australia: Check His 2026 Tour Dates
summary: The chart-topping U.S. pop artist will perform nine total concerts in Brisbane, Melbourne and Sydney.
contentText:
Benson Boone will backflip into Australia later this year for an east coast arena jaunt.

The chart-topping U.S. pop artist brings his Wanted Man run to these parts in November 2026, for nine total concerts spread across Brisbane Entertainment Centre, Melbourne’s Rod Laver Arena and Sydney’s Afterpay Arena (formerly Qudos Bank Arena).

But first, the Grammy-nominated singer will complete the U.S. leg of his tour , a 35-date trek that got underway Tuesday, July 7 at PPG Paints Arena in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and wraps up Sept. 3 at Wyoming Center in Casper, WY. Along the way, he’ll play multiple nights at Brooklyn’s Barclays Center and Los Angeles’ Crypto.com Arena, and he’s booked to perform at the iHeartRadio Music Festival in Las Vegas, presented Sept. 18-19.

Frontier Touring is producing the Australia trek, his first here since Boone completed six sold-out shows across a mix of arenas, outdoor spaces and theaters in January 2025.

Aussie audiences have a soft spot for Boone. His sophomore album,  American Heart , opened at No. 1 on the ARIA Chart following its release in June 2025. That easily surpassed the No. 17 peak of his debut full-length effort, Fireworks & Rollerblades , which housed the smash “Beautiful Things ,” the leader on ARIA’s year-end singles chart for 2024. “Beautiful Things” would also win the IFPI Global Single Award for 2024, effectively the world’s best-performing single across all digital formats, and its official music video recently entered YouTube’s Billion Views Club.

Boone kick-started the next phase of his career with the release last month of “The Time of My Life” (via Warner Records), penned with his go-to collaborators Jack LaFrantz and producer Jason Evigan.

Register for his forthcoming Australia tour at frontiertouring.com/bensonboone .
